title: print: with avoidBreakInside on, a record:line_items table that does not fit the rest of sheet 1 moves whole to sheet 2 (measure on the real page first)
body:
repo:objectstack#1 · os-project-manager · session_01FEkQ5pmEYLVFDcQ1Z1CS8H

Filing gate: ① a defect, measured so far on a simplified page only. Step 6 of the maintainer's ruling record on #34228 (comment 6922479414) asks for this card and says it is **not** part of that ruling.

`reach:` not yet measured on the real print-page DOM. The first acceptance item measures it before anything is built.

## What was seen

With `print.avoidBreakInside` on, a `record:line_items` table that does not fit in the rest of sheet 1 moves whole to sheet 2. Sheet 1 then holds only the customer block. This was measured by the #34228 decision thread on a simplified page, plain HTML in Chromium, not the real print-page DOM (probe: `/mnt/project-files/pm-orders/review/34228-pagination-probe.mjs`):

- At 26, 28, 31 and 36 lines, the table starts on sheet 2.
- At 26, 28 and 31 lines, that is one sheet more than with the key off.

A template cannot fix this, because a table is one block. The print stylesheet applies `break-inside: avoid` to every region child (`ui/packages/components/src/renderers/layout/page-print.ts`).

## Acceptance

1. Measure on the real print page (the quote or invoice print page in the showcase): from how many lines the table moves whole, and how much of sheet 1 is left blank. If it does not reproduce on the real page, close with the reading.
2. If it reproduces, propose a fix that keeps the published meaning of `avoidBreakInside` ("keep each block whole on one sheet when it fits"). An example is letting a block taller than the space left start on the current sheet when it cannot fit any single sheet. If the fix needs the published meaning to change, that is a new maintainer decision, not something built here.

Duplicate check: `is:issue avoidBreakInside` found 4 hits; the only open one is #34228. The closed hits (#22271, #22158, #23392) introduced the key and its docs.
